title: Jamaican Pasta Bake
description: A flavorful twist on traditional pasta bake, infused with the bold flavors of Jamaica. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat aromatic oil over medium heat. Add broken pasta and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked macaroni, pasta, light cream, jamaican seasoning, and shredded cheese. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped scallions.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
